title: The Priests Begin Their Ministry

questions.question: On what day did Moses call Aaron and his sons to begin their ministry?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:1 (ESV): "On the eighth day Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel."

questions.question: What offering did Aaron present for himself?
options: A bull calf for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering
questions.correctAnswer: A bull calf for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:2 (ESV): "Take for yourself a bull calf for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering."

questions.question: What was the result of the glory of the Lord appearing to all the people?
options: Fire came out from before the Lord and consumed the offering
questions.correctAnswer: Fire came out from before the Lord and consumed the offering
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:24 (ESV): "And fire came out from before the Lord and consumed the burnt offering and the pieces of fat on the altar."

questions.question: How did the people react to the fire from the Lord?
options: They shouted and fell on their faces
questions.correctAnswer: They shouted and fell on their faces
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:24 (ESV): "And when all the people saw it, they shouted and fell on their faces."

questions.question: Who blessed the people after the offerings?
options: Aaron first, then both Moses and Aaron
questions.correctAnswer: Aaron first, then both Moses and Aaron
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:22-23 (ESV): "Then Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them... And Moses and Aaron went into the tent of meeting, and when they came out they blessed the people."

questions.question: What did the congregation bring for a sin offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:3 (ESV): "Take a male goat for a sin offering."

questions.question: Why were these offerings made on this specific day?
options: For today the Lord will appear to you
questions.correctAnswer: For today the Lord will appear to you
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:4 (ESV): "For today the Lord will appear to you."

questions.question: What did Aaron do with the blood of his sin offering?
options: Put it on the horns of the altar and poured the rest at the base
questions.correctAnswer: Put it on the horns of the altar and poured the rest at the base
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:9 (ESV): "He dipped his finger in the blood and put it on the horns of the altar and poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar."

questions.question: What parts of the sin offering were burned on the altar?
options: The fat and the kidneys and the lobe of the liver
questions.correctAnswer: The fat and the kidneys and the lobe of the liver
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:10 (ESV): "But the fat and the kidneys and the long lobe of the liver from the sin offering he burned on the altar."

questions.question: What happened to the flesh and skin of Aaron's sin offering?
options: Burned with fire outside the camp
questions.correctAnswer: Burned with fire outside the camp
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:11 (ESV): "The flesh and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp."

questions.question: What kind of offering accompanied the burnt offering?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:17 (ESV): "And he presented the grain offering..."

questions.question: What animals were brought for the people's peace offerings?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:4 (ESV): "And an ox and a ram for peace offerings to sacrifice before the Lord."

questions.question: What did Aaron do with the breasts and right thighs of the people's offering?
options: Waved them for a wave offering
questions.correctAnswer: Waved them for a wave offering
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:21 (ESV): "And the breasts and the right thighs Aaron waved for a wave offering before the Lord."

questions.question: Who handed the blood to Aaron during the service?
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:12 (ESV): "And his sons handed him the blood, and he threw it against the sides of the altar."

questions.question: The appearance of God's glory was conditional on what?
options: Doing the thing that the Lord commanded
questions.correctAnswer: Doing the thing that the Lord commanded
questions.explanation: Leviticus 9:6 (ESV): "This is the thing that the Lord commanded you to do, that the glory of the Lord may appear to you."

key_verse_text: And fire came out from before the Lord and consumed the burnt offering and the pieces of fat on the altar, and when all the people saw it, they shouted and fell on their faces.
